description: Detect and repair dangerous Rust lock lifetimes using structured syntax, rust-analyzer semantics, compiler verification and lock-order analysis.
name: lockscope

destructive_operations: rewrites one Rust source file in repair mode, moving a single lock acquisition
security.reviewed_by: Frozen production-strength evaluation on Ubuntu and macOS (PASS_V2, workflow run 31823072283), reproduced locally on rustc 1.97.1 before release.

tests.coverage: 142 tests: 82 structural, 45 semantic against rust-analyzer, 5 compiler Send probes and 10 runtime repair proofs; 17 more against three pinned real repositories

verifications.findings: PASS_V2. One infrastructure-only amendment: macOS system Python refused a global pip install under PEP 668, so the pinned packages moved into a virtual environment. No expectation, threshold or repository commit changed.
verifications.method: Preregistered protocol: 20 inherited semantic cases plus 5 structured-syntax cases on Ubuntu and macOS, 4 compiler Send probes, lock-order cycles, deterministic replay, a Tokio contention repair proof, and three pinned real repositories.
